Motive empowers the people who run physical operations with tools to make their work safer, more productive, and more profitable. For the first time ever, safety, operations and finance teams can manage their drivers, vehicles, equipment, and fleet related spend in a single system. Combined with industry leading AI, the Motive platform gives you complete visibility and control, and significantly reduces manual workloads by automating and simplifying tasks.
Motive serves nearly 100,000 customers – from Fortune 500 enterprises to small businesses – across a wide range of industries, including transportation and logistics, construction, energy, field service, manufacturing, agriculture, food and beverage, retail, and the public sector.
Visit gomotive.com to learn more.

As an Enterprise Account Executive at Motive, you are responsible for developing and closing business with Motive’s largest prospects. You will sell into the most impactful companies in North America that power the physical economy.

We are seizing the opportunity created by our strong product positioning in the market by heavily investing across all Go-To-Market (GTM) teams within our Enterprise segment. You will lead the charge, selling the value of our products and the business outcomes that can be achieved in partnership with Motive.
Our Enterprise Account Executives sell across multiple industries, including trucking, oil & gas, construction, agriculture, manufacturing, consumer transit, or any other business that requires a fleet of vehicles. You are receptive to feedback, have a willingness to learn, a strong technical aptitude, and a high attention to detail.

Because of the collaborative nature of our Go-to-Market team, a win-as-a-team mentality is a must. In this high-energy role, you should be comfortable working in a fast-paced environment with high standards of quality.
Open Territory: West Coast (Open to individuals located in California, Oregon or Washington)

Prospect and win new Enterprise business through developing key executive relationships within key prospects to drive expansion of that business with all key accounts, growing share of wallet through developing a deep understanding of each client’s business and identifying opportunities for additional collaboration
Harness key Executive relationships to ensure RFP wins and grow contractual-based business
Partner with the balance of your account team and leverage customer analytics and other available resources to optimize buying decisions
Resolve problems, including identifying issues, thinking critically to determine the optimal course of action, and implementing best available solutions
Work with technical resources to display to prospects the power of integrations & how our partner ecosystem increases the value of our hardware and software
Effectively plan to meet and exceed your ongoing business goals and revenue quotas
Develop a deep understanding of our technology platform and operations, using that understanding and market input to bring back iterations to our business
Constantly study and deepen understanding of market trends to enable consultative insight

You have deep Enterprise sales experience partnering with F1000 clients
4+ years of SaaS or industry relevant Enterprise field sales experience required
You show a strong track record of exceeding quotas and rapidly growing your book over time backed up by data
You have an ability to build rapport with executive decision-makers, influencing outcomes through both an understanding of the customer’s business and the unique solutions that Motive can deliver
You show a history of working independently with a data-driven mindset for charting a path to short, medium, and long-term sales goals
You have best-in-class communication skills, with the ability to successfully convey key value propositions and quick manage objections
Pay Transparency
Your compensation may be based on several factors, including education, work experience, and certifications. For certain roles, total compensation may include restricted stock units.

Stellenangebot: Senior Account Executive – Enterprise Industrial Software (m/w/d) Für unser Unternehmen, einen führenden SaaS-Enablement-Dienstleister , suchen wir zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt eine/n engagierte/n und erfahrene/n Senior Account Executive – Enterprise Industrial Software (m/w/d) .

SingularitySales ist bekannt für erstklassige Leistungen im Bereich Go-to-Market und der Skalierung innovativer Softwarelösungen. Wir legen besonderen Wert auf eine moderne Unternehmenskultur, die Offenheit, Innovation und kontinuierliche Weiterentwicklung fördert.

Als Senior Account Executive (m/w/d) bist du eine zentrale Säule unseres Vertriebsteams im Bereich Enterprise Industrial Software und spielst eine entscheidende Rolle beim Aufbau und Closing strategischer Deals mit Großkunden aus dem Fertigungsumfeld.

Dein Fokus liegt darauf, Kundenbedarfe präzise zu analysieren, maßgeschneiderte Softwarelösungen zu präsentieren und Entscheidungsträger bis zum erfolgreichen Vertragsabschluss zu begleiten. Dabei baust du langfristige Partnerschaften auf und positionierst das Produkt-Portfolio strategisch in deinem Marktbereich.

Wenn du dich durch exzellente kommunikative Fähigkeiten, starkes Business-Verständnis im industriellen Umfeld und eine nachweisbare Erfolgsbilanz im Closing komplexer Enterprise-Deals auszeichnest, freuen wir uns auf deine Unterstützung.

Dich erwartet eine anspruchsvolle Rolle mit hoher Verantwortung – und die Möglichkeit, deine Karriere auf das nächste Level zu bringen, eingebettet in ein dynamisches Umfeld, das lebenslanges Lernen, Entwicklung und gemeinsame Erfolge fördert.

Sei Teil eines Teams, das mit Leidenschaft innovative Softwarelösungen vorantreibt, nachhaltige Kundenbeziehungen aufbaut und ambitionierte Wachstumsziele realisiert. Requirements Deine Mission: Als Senior Account Executive (m/w/d) bist du Teil unseres Outsourcing-Teams für einen führenden Anbieter industrieller Softwarelösungen.

Deine Mission: den kompletten Sales-Cycle eigenverantwortlich zu steuern – von der präzisen Analyse der Kundenbedarfe über die Präsentation maßgeschneiderter Enterprise-Lösungen bis hin zum erfolgreichen Vertragsabschluss.

Dabei agierst du als vertrauensvoller Partner im Namen unseres Kunden, baust langfristige Beziehungen mit Entscheidungsträgern auf und positionierst das Portfolio strategisch im Markt. Mit deinem Beitrag stellst du sicher, dass Wachstum messbar wird und die Sales-Exzellenz unseres Kunden nachhaltig gestärkt wird.

Deine Aufgaben: Closing & Deal Ownership: Verantwortung für den gesamten Abschlussprozess – vom ersten Meeting (ausführliche Discovery und Business Case) bis hin zur erfolgreichen Vertragsunterzeichnung.

Kundenberatung: Analyse komplexer Anforderungen aus dem Manufacturing- und Industrieumfeld, Präsentation maßgeschneiderter Softwarelösungen und Positionierung des Produktportfolios als strategischer Mehrwert.

Beziehungsmanagement: Aufbau und Pflege langfristiger Partnerschaften mit Entscheidern und Key Accounts in Fertigungsunternehmen, um nachhaltiges Wachstum zu sichern. Vertriebsstrategie: Entwicklung und Umsetzung von Go-to-Market-Ansätzen im Namen des Kunden, mit Fokus auf Effizienz und Impact im industriellen Enterprise-Umfeld.

CRM- & Pipeline-Management: Sicherstellen einer präzisen Forecasting- und Opportunity-Steuerung im CRM-System, um volle Transparenz über den Sales-Funnel zu gewährleisten. Markt- & Wettbewerbsanalyse: Beobachtung von Trends im Bereich Industrial Software & Manufacturing, um Chancen frühzeitig zu erkennen und Kunden proaktiv zu beraten.

Reporting & KPI-Steuerung: Erstellung von regelmäßigen Berichten zu Sales-Performance, Conversion Rates und Forecasts für Management und Stakeholder. Dein Profil: Mehrjährige Erfahrung im B2B-Solution-Selling, idealerweise im Bereich Enterprise Software, Industrial Software oder SaaS im Fertigungsumfeld.

Nachweisbare Erfolge im Closing komplexer Deals und in der Erreichung oder Übertreffung ambitionierter Vertriebsziele. Tiefes Verständnis für industrielle Geschäftsmodelle sowie die Fähigkeit, technische Softwarelösungen in klaren Business-Value zu übersetzen.

Starke kommunikative und überzeugende Fähigkeiten auf C-Level – schriftlich, telefonisch und in Präsentationen. Erfahrung im Umgang mit CRM-Systemen, Forecasting und Opportunity-Management. Strategisches Mindset kombiniert mit Hands-on-Mentalität, um Kunden durch den gesamten Sales Cycle zu führen.

Hohe Eigenmotivation, strukturierte Arbeitsweise und die Fähigkeit, in einem dynamischen internationalen Umfeld erfolgreich zu agieren. Wir bieten: 100% Remote – arbeite von wo du willst, in einem globalen Team mit echtem Impact. Ein wettbewerbsfähiges Gehaltspaket inklusive leistungsbezogener Boni.

Direkter Zugang zu Entscheidern – kurze Wege, schnelle Entscheidungen. Ein Umfeld, das High Performer fordert und fördert – ohne Corporate-Bremsen. Ein engagiertes und leidenschaftliches Team, das Werte wie Innovation, Integrität und Teamarbeit hochhält.

Cleaned Document About the role and team Sales at Uber means navigating ambiguity, earning trust fast, and solving problems that don't come with a script.

As an Account Executive for Uber Eats, you are on the frontline of our fastest-growing business, introducing restaurant partners to our platform and helping them grow their businesses in an increasingly competitive landscape.

This role isn't about pushing a product-it's about building long-term partnerships in a fast-changing environment where the pace is intense and the stakes are high. You'll need to be resilient, resourceful, and energized by the messy reality of the sales cycle, moving with urgency to turn prospects into successful, high-performing partners.

What you'll do Manage the entire end-to-end sales cycle, from prospecting and cold calling to pitching, contract negotiation, and closing deals that drive significant business growth. Leverage local knowledge to identify and bring on the best restaurants in strategic markets, ensuring our selection meets the diverse needs of our users.

Communicate the value of Uber Eats and our latest product features clearly, removing barriers to entry and helping partners reach their specific business goals. Collaborate across operations and onboarding teams to ensure a seamless transition for new partners, setting them up for measurable success within their first month on the platform.

Own restaurant partner performance during the critical first 28 days, providing consultative support to ensure a strong start and long-term retention. Proactively identify and redesign inefficient internal processes, ensuring the team can move quickly and succeed at a massive scale despite shifting priorities.

Basic Qualifications Minimum 1 year of professional experience in a quota-carrying sales role. Proven experience negotiating contracts and managing a complex sales pipeline. Demonstrated ability to identify customer needs and present tailored solutions. Proficiency in CRM software, such as Salesforce, to manage sales activities.

Degree level education (Bachelor's degree or equivalent). Preferred Qualifications Experience in the food delivery, hospitality, or e-commerce marketplace industries. Extraordinary listening and communication skills, with the ability to adjust your style to a wide variety of audiences.

A resourceful and persistent attitude, with a relentless drive to achieve goals and overcome objections. Strong critical thinking and problem-solving abilities in a fast-paced, high-pressure environment. Proven track record of meeting and exceeding monthly and quarterly sales targets. Ready to Ride?

This isn't the kind of place where you follow a playbook - it's where you help write one. If you're driven by impact, energized by challenge, and ready to shape how the world moves - we'd love to hear from you. You may be eligible for bonuses, equity, and other compensation, as well as a range of benefits. Explore our benefits.

Position Summary Ironmark is seeking a Strategic Account Manager to support franchisees and local operators participating in multi-location marketing programs.

This role serves as the primary day-to-day contact for assigned locations, helping them understand available services, make informed marketing decisions, and get greater value from their investment.

The Strategic Account Manager connects each location’s business goals with coordinated execution across paid media, SEO, social media, content, creative, web, analytics, print, and marketing technology.

They guide onboarding, maintain proactive communication, explain performance clearly, and help local owners navigate priorities, opportunities, and challenges. The right person will bring digital agency experience, a strong understanding of multi-location marketing, and the confidence to manage a large portfolio of local client relationships.

They should be comfortable advising business owners, interpreting performance, resolving concerns, and coordinating work across internal service teams.

Primary Responsibilities & Ownership The Strategic Account Manager owns the day-to-day experience, health, and growth of assigned location relationships, ensuring each client receives clear guidance, responsive support, and a consistent experience within the broader brand program.

Serve as the primary day-to-day contact for assigned franchisees, local operators, and participating locations. Lead recurring location meetings, performance conversations, onboarding sessions, and planning discussions. Translate each location’s business goals, market conditions, and budget into clear marketing priorities and next steps.

Coordinate integrated programs across paid media, SEO, social media, content, creative, web, analytics, print, and other services. Monitor location satisfaction, engagement, program adoption, performance trends, and potential risks across the assigned portfolio.

Proactively address concerns and lead difficult location-level conversations with clarity, professionalism, and sound judgment. Partner with channel specialists to interpret performance and present practical, business-focused recommendations.

Identify opportunities to improve retention, increase service adoption, and expand location participation through relevant Ironmark services.

Key Areas of Focus Location Relationship Management & Strategic Guidance Build credibility with franchisees and local operators by understanding their business goals, market conditions, challenges, and growth priorities. Help location clients prioritize marketing opportunities based on business impact, available budget, and operational readiness.

Multi-Location Program Management Manage a scalable portfolio of location relationships within larger franchise and multi-location programs. Lead location onboarding, education, adoption, and ongoing engagement across available marketing services.

Deliver a consistent client experience while adapting guidance to each location’s market, maturity, goals, and needs. Digital Marketing Strategy & Performance Understand how paid media, SEO, content, social media, web, analytics, and related services work together.

Review performance with channel experts and translate data into clear insights, recommendations, and business implications. Connect brand-level strategy and reporting with practical location-level execution, performance, and next steps.

Cross-Functional Coordination & Growth Coordinate between location clients and Ironmark ’s strategy, media, SEO, creative, web, analytics, operations, and production teams. Create clear internal direction, confirm ownership, surface risks early, and keep deliverables moving.

Partner with leadership on location retention, account planning, service adoption, and opportunities to expand participation. Qualifications Required 4+ years of client-facing account management, strategy, or client services experience in a digital marketing agency. Direct experience supporting franchise or another multi-location business model.

Experience managing a large portfolio of client relationships, workstreams, timelines, and stakeholders at the same time. Working knowledge of paid media, SEO, content, web, analytics, and performance reporting. Ability to interpret marketing data, identify meaningful trends, and communicate practical recommendations to local business owners.

Strong written, verbal, presentation, and relationship-building skills, including the ability to navigate difficult client conversations professionally. Preferred Experience working directly with franchisees, dealers, local operators, or individual locations within a larger brand system.

Familiarity with CRM, project management, reporting, call tracking, and marketing automation tools. What Makes Someone Successful in This Role The ideal candidate understands that strong location account management is more than responsiveness.

They anticipate needs, create clarity, connect marketing activity to local business goals, and help owners make better decisions while maintaining a consistent client experience across a large portfolio.

They understand the complexity of multi-location marketing and can earn trust with franchisees and local operators who need practical guidance, reliable follow-through, and measurable value. They communicate directly, stay organized, remain calm under pressure, and bring the right internal resources together to solve problems.

Why Join Ironmark Ironmark is a growing marketing services company that brings digital, creative, print, production, data, and technology together for multi-location and franchise brands.

This role is an opportunity to work with complex client organizations, shape scalable marketing programs, and help clients connect national strategy with meaningful local-market execution. EEO Statement Ironmark is an equal opportunity employer.

what you will do About Gnosis Pay Gnosis Pay provides the API and card-program infrastructure that enables wallets, fintechs, and businesses to issue stablecoin-powered payment cards and create custom payment flows. Partners can easily connect on-chain wallets to real-world spending.

With our technology, users can spend stablecoins directly from their on-chain wallet using a Visa debit card. Transactions are executed through a secure smart-wallet rather than a traditional bank account, allowing users to retain full custody of their assets while paying anywhere Visa is accepted.

You'll own the entire sales cycle—from prospecting to signed agreements—and play a key role in expanding Gnosis Pay's enterprise customer base across the region.

This role is ideal for someone who thrives in fast-paced startup environments, enjoys building relationships with senior decision-makers, and has a proven ability to close complex enterprise deals. Key Responsibilities Enterprise Business Developement Identify, qualify, and close new enterprise partnerships across Europe.

Build and manage a healthy sales pipeline through outbound prospecting, networking, referrals, and industry events. Own the complete enterprise sales cycle, from first contact through contract negotiation and signature.

Develop relationships with C-level executives and senior stakeholders within fintech, crypto, payments, and financial services companies. Commercial Execution Understand customer needs and position Gnosis Pay's infrastructure as the preferred solution. Prepare and deliver commercial proposals tailored to each opportunity.

Lead commercial negotiations alongside internal legal, product, and compliance teams. Consistently achieve and exceed commercial targets. Market Development Represent Gnosis Pay at conferences, industry events, and networking opportunities across Europe. Build strong relationships within the European fintech and crypto ecosystem.

Continuously identify new market opportunities and strategic partnerships Market Intelligence Monitoring industry trends, competitive activities and emerging opportunities.

Share customer insights and market feedback to help shape product priorities and commercial strategies. who you are 5+ years of experience in Enterprise Sales, Business Development, or Strategic Partnerships. Proven track record of sourcing and closing high-value B2B enterprise deals.

Experience selling to fintechs, payment companies, crypto companies, digital wallets, banks, or financial institutions. Experience managing long and complex enterprise sales cycles involving multiple stakeholders. Strong negotiation and commercial relationship management skills.

Comfortable operating independently in a fast-paced startup environment. Excellent communication and presentation skills in English. Willingness to travel across Europe as needed. Preferred Qualifications Existing network within the European fintech and crypto ecosystem.

Experience selling API-based products, payment infrastructure, Banking-as-a-Service, card issuing, embedded finance, or similar financial infrastructure solutions. Familiarity with blockchain, stablecoins, digital assets, or crypto payments.

Previous experience in a high-growth fintech or Web3 company. what we can offer you Personal Development: Pursue your professional goals with our support, including personal education budgets and conference allowances. We invest in your growth and learning. Innovation and Experimentation: Interested in exploring new ideas?

Dedicate your Friday afternoons to research or work on a side project within our ecosystem. We encourage creativity and experimentation. Flat Hierarchy: Navigate with ease in our organization. Our flat hierarchy ensures your ideas and contributions are valued and heard, without getting lost in a complex structure.

We make sure you're well-equipped to do your best work. Growth and Opportunity: Grow with us in an exciting industry. As Gnosis rapidly expands, so do the opportunities for you to make a significant impact. We value initiative and a proactive approach.

Community and Mission: Join a team that's passionate about our mission and enjoys working together. We’re not just colleagues; we’re a community driven by a shared goal. At Gnosis , we strive to create an inclusive environment that empowers our team members.

Für ein international tätiges Maschinenbauunternehmen mit Sitz in Bremen suchen wir einen International Sales Manager (all genders) mit klarem Hunter-Fokus für den weltweiten Ausbau des Projektgeschäfts im Bereich Sonderanlagen.
Aufgaben
Sie akquirieren aktiv internationale Neukunden (ca. 80 %) im Anlagen- und Projektgeschäft.
Sie steuern den gesamten Vertriebsprozess – von der technischen Klärung über die Angebotserstellung bis zum Vertragsabschluss.
Sie bearbeiten internationale Ausschreibungen und prüfen englischsprachige Spezifikationen.
Sie analysieren Marktpotenziale und identifizieren neue Anwendungen, um gezielt Märkte außerhalb Europas aufzubauen, schwerpunktmäßig Asien (Reisetätigkeit ca. 30 %).
Sie arbeiten eng mit Konstruktion und Projektmanagement am Standort Bremen zusammen.
Sie repräsentieren das Unternehmen bei internationalen Kundenterminen, Fachmessen und Branchenveranstaltungen.
Qualifikation
Sie verfügen über ein Studium im Bereich Verfahrenstechnik, Maschinenbau oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation – alternativ über eine kaufmännische oder technische Ausbildung mit entsprechender Vertriebserfahrung.
Sie konnten bereits Erfahrungen im beratungsintensiven technischen Vertrieb sammeln, idealerweise in internationalem Kontext.
Sie bringen Erfahrung aus dem Anlagenbau mit, idealerweise in der Fest-Flüssig-Trennung oder Wasseraufbereitung.
Sie bewegen sich sicher im Projektgeschäft mit Volumina ab 5 Mio. €.
Sie kommunizieren sicher in Deutsch und Englisch.
Sie arbeiten eigenständig, unternehmerisch und sind international reisebereit.

Most sales roles come with a category problem: you spend the first half of every call convincing someone the type of thing you sell is worth caring about. This one doesn't. Nearly 500 customers in DACH are running doinstruct on their factory floors and in their logistics operations because they had an operational problem they couldn't fix any other way. Sub-2% churn across those customers means they haven't found a reason to leave.
The role sits inside a vertical pod with a dedicated SDR. Pipeline is a shared effort: SDR-generated leads plus your own outbound. The sales motion is consultative throughout, built on MEDDIC qualification and Command of the Message discovery. Deals don't reach a demo stage until they're qualified, which means the pipeline is smaller than most and the close rate is expected to reflect that.
🎯 What you'll own
Build pipeline in corporate and midmarket accounts (200-5,000 employees) across manufacturing, logistics, and construction in DACH, working your pod's SDR-generated leads and contributing your own outbound alongside.
Run discovery conversations that shift how prospects understand their frontline operations problem. Connect operational friction to euros before the product enters the conversation.
Qualify hard against MEDDIC criteria and kill deals early when the signal isn't there. Your forecast credibility depends on it.
Build business cases that reach Geschäftsführer or Operations Director level without a sales overlay.
Close multi-stakeholder deals, including multi-year contracts when the fit is there.

Full-cycle AE experience at a B2B SaaS company, preferably in manufacturing, logistics, or operational enterprise environments.
Track record of building your own outbound alongside SDR support, with specific accounts you personally initiated and moved forward.
Practiced use of MEDDIC or a comparable qualification framework across your full pipeline.
Experience selling to operations or line-of-business decision-makers in the 200-5,000 employee range, reaching the economic buyer independently.
Fluent German.
🤩 What's different here
Most buyers in this space have tried to fix the frontline training problem with spreadsheets or manual workarounds, and they're still carrying it.

There's no worn category here, no "we had a bad experience with something similar." You're selling a solution most prospects didn't know existed as a working option, backed by 500 customers who can confirm it does. The conversation starts from the premise that the problem is real.

The work is getting prospects to put a number on what it's costing them, before you've mentioned a feature.
The harder part is qualification discipline. The sales process is designed around a 70% close rate on qualified opportunities, and that's only achievable if the pipeline reflects actual deals. Carrying something that should be killed costs more than walking away early. For the right seller, that constraint is what makes the role worth doing.
🚀 Why doinstruct
Nearly 500 customers in DACH, Series A funded, sub-2% churn. The market proof is real.
Georg Wesinger coaches the methodology directly, in the deals you're working rather than through quarterly dashboards.
The sales team is senior. You'll get better at your craft by being in the room.
Vertical focus means you build real expertise in specific markets over time, not a generalist territory that resets every two years.

Nobody succeeds at Sprinto by staying in their lane.
We are organized around problems, not job titles. Sprinters take ownership beyond their role, solve hard problems, and care deeply about the impact they create. If something can be improved, fixed, or built, we don't wait for permission; we step in.
Being remote means we rely less on proximity and more on trust. We write things down, communicate openly, and move quickly because great teams aren't built by sitting together, they're built by pulling in the same direction.
We believe progress beats perfection, feedback is a gift, and doing the right thing matters, even when nobody is watching.
And while we move with urgency, we never move alone.
The mission -
Sprinto is building the next phase of its outbound sales engine and this isn't a traditional SDR role.
You'll own a Target Account List of US-based mid-market and enterprise companies and run the full outbound motion to get the right GRC buyers in front of our Account Executives. Your mission is simple: map the accounts, find the right people, start meaningful conversations, and consistently create pipeline that turns into revenue.

Where you'll leave your mark?
Own a high-volume Launch portfolio — renewals, upsells, and day-to-day relationships across a large book of startup and early-stage SMB accounts, prioritising by risk and value rather than treating every account the same way.
Run the renewal pipeline end to end — track renewals well ahead of expiry, forecast accurately , and close on time; a slow renewal is the fastest way to lose a low-touch account.

Negotiate commercial terms with confidence — pricing, discounts, and contract length, knowing when to hold firm and when to flex, especially on multi-year commitments.
Spot and close expansion opportunities — accounts ready to add frameworks (SOC 2 to ISO 27001, GDPR, HIPAA) or upgrade plans, pitched naturally within renewal conversations.
Get ahead of payment and billing risk — step in early on failed payments or lapsed billing before it turns into churn, one of the biggest causes of loss in this segment.

Work the system, not just the relationship — use CRM workflows, templates, and playbooks to manage volume efficiently, keeping renewal stage, risk flags, and outcomes logged in real time.
Partner cross-functionally with Customer Success, Sales, Finance, and the audit team to unblock renewals, resolve billing disputes, and report regularly on portfolio health .

The knowledge that holds manufacturing together - part costs, suppliers, materials - is scattered across systems and people.

Why It Matters
Manufacturing forms Europe's economic backbone, driving a fourth of Europe's GDP and providing over 30% of jobs. These hidden champions and global market leaders manufacture the physical world around us, from the machines that build our cities to the medical devices that save lives.
But the world is changing. The US dominates the digital world of bits. China is scaling the world of atoms, manufacturing at unprecedented speed and scale. Geopolitics are more uncertain than ever. The global banking architecture is undergoing a foundational paradigm shift. Strong negotiation, communication and stakeholder-management skills, with fluent English.

Negotiate data usage and commercial agreements with key agency and advertiser partners.
Represent Adsquare credibly with senior agency and advertiser stakeholders, communicating the company's value proposition, positioning and vision with clarity.
Maintain a strong presence across the UK programmatic, agency and advertising community, using your existing network alongside targeted new-business development to generate opportunities.

About Tekmetric
Tekmetric is the all-in-one, cloud-based software helping auto repair shops run smarter, grow faster, and serve customers better.
Built by a shop owner and shaped by the needs of the industry, Tekmetric brings together innovation, real-world experience, and a thriving community to help shops thrive - not just survive. From running a shop, to securing payments to engaging customers, our platform simplifies operations so shop owners can focus on what really matters: delivering exceptional service, earning trust, and growing sustainably.
Officially founded in Houston in 2017, Tekmetric has grown from a single shop’s vision to the industry’s leading solution - all by staying true to our values of transparency, integrity, innovation, and a service-first mindset.
But we’re not just building shop management software. We’re building a movement. We’re empowering repair shops to rise above the daily grind, create meaningful connections with their customers, and lead the industry forward - one interaction at a time.
Come build with us. Join the journey. Shape the future of auto repair.
Working the Tekmetric Way
At Tekmetric, we’re building a culture where winning matters - not for ego, but because when our customers win, we win together.
We move fast, stay curious, and take full ownership of our results — no excuses, no finger-pointing. If you thrive in ambiguity, take initiative, and view honest feedback as fuel for growth, you’ll feel right at home here.
We’re direct but respectful, ambitious yet grounded, and collaborative at every level. Everyone leads through impact and is encouraged to speak up, share ideas, and challenge assumptions (even your manager’s). This is a place for builders, not bystanders.
Success here takes focus, follow-through, and a willingness to roll up your sleeves — but if you’re driven by meaningful work and real results, it’s deeply rewarding. You’ll join a team that cares about the work, supports one another, and takes smart risks to achieve bold goals. Be yourself, stay mission-focused, and you’ll thrive. If that energizes you, we can’t wait to meet you.
At Tekmetric, great work happens anywhere, but great teams are built through intentional connection . We offer hybrid and remote work models based on your proximity to our office hubs. Because we value in-person collaboration, travel is an expected part of every role. We come together several times a year for team and company-wide offsites to align on goals and strengthen relationships. Attendance at these events is expected and fully supported.

s.h: THIS IS A REAL STEP INTO CLOSING
s.t:
You booked the meeting. Someone else closed it. Not here.
Your number. Your accounts. Your calls. Your deals. Start to finish.
You already know this feeling
You worked the account for weeks. You found the pain, you got the right person on the phone, you booked the meeting. Then you handed it over and watched someone else take it to signature and pick up the commission.
This is the seat where you keep it.

You own a UK and Ireland mid-market patch and carry a monthly new-business ARR target. You find every opportunity yourself, and you close it yourself. There is no SDR underneath you and nobody filling your diary. We give you the data, the tools, the coaching and a few live opportunities to get you moving. Everything after that is yours to build.
If that reads as a warning, this is not your role. If it reads as an opportunity, keep going.
What you’ll actually be doing
Picking your target accounts and going after them properly
Cold calling. Every week. It does not stop being part of the job when you start closing
Running discovery that reaches business impact, not a feature checklist
Demoing Joblogic to operations directors, finance and business owners
Multi-threading, building the commercial case, negotiating and closing
Keeping HubSpot honest and forecasting a number you are happy to be held to
What we’ll give you
A structured 90-day ramp into discovery, demonstrations, commercials and closing. You will never be guessing what good looks like
Full coaching as standard: MEDDPICC is our qualification standard and we will teach it to you, alongside discovery, demo and negotiation training, weekly call reviews and deal clinics
Live opportunities at the start to get you selling while you build your own engine
The data, tooling and tech stack to prospect properly, so your time goes on selling rather than list building
A real career, with a fast-growing, PE-backed software business scaling to £100M ARR. This is the first seat of a career here, not the last
You’ll love this if
You have 12-36 months as an SDR or BDR and you have smashed your number, and you can prove it with real figures
A cold call that turns into a deal is still the best part of your week
You are competitive with yourself before you are competitive with anyone else
You want feedback, not comfort, and you act on it fast
You want to be judged on ARR, not on dials and diary entries
You are curious about how businesses actually make money, not just about hitting activity targets

You want your pipeline handed to you.
You think prospecting stops the day you start closing.
Your best answer to “how did you perform?” is “the team hit target”.
Joblogic in thirty seconds
We are the UK’s #1 Field Service Management software platform. Founded in 1998, ~£35M ARR, 500+ people and over 100,000 users across HVAC, plumbing, electrical maintenance, facilities management and building fabric maintenance. We are backed by Vista Equity Partners with over £100 million of new capital behind us, and we are scaling to £100M ARR with an AI-first product roadmap.
Put simply: the market is huge, the product wins, and the ceiling on this team has just been lifted. We need people who want to run at that.

Send us your CV, and tell us in a few lines about the best opportunity you have ever self-sourced (In the Cover Letter). How you found it, how you got in, what happened next. We are far more interested in that than in how your CV is formatted.
Bring energy. This team runs on it.

As a founding Mid Market Account Executive for Toast Retail, you will source and close multi-location retail deals with a focus on grocery, liquor, and convenience operators. Open source software is the new default in the enterprise, and Canonical is the new challenger to major enterprise software vendors.
We deliver better open source from the data center to cloud and edge. Our Linux distribution Ubuntu is now the leading platform for public cloud compute, and the favorite platform for software engineers, data scientists and AI developers.

Our mission is to accelerate the adoption and quality of open source globally, and our goal is to ship the most software on the planet by cores. A tidal wave of open source innovation is the next phase of the entire enterprise software industry, and we aim to be the most compelling way to ride that wave.
Our customers include Global 500 enterprises and startups. We are expanding our product range from the base operating system - Ubuntu - to full enterprise solutions in infrastructure and applications.

We can deliver software defined storage, private cloud solutions, container runtime environments, as well as databases, message queues, identity, observability, analytics, machine learning and web publishing capabilities. Customers love the idea that they can get security compliance and support for everything open source from a single company.

Our goal is to have more solutions on tap than any other vendor, and we have built unique capabilities to make that possible across every cloud, every class of compute and every category of application.
Canonical provides licensed enterprise software products, commercial support, managed services, consulting and training services to customers who are deploying Ubuntu or open source applications on the cloud, in their data center, or to the connected device and IoT ecosystem.

We are just over 1,000 colleagues in 70+ countries and $250m in revenue, profitable, on a steady but relentless growth trajectory. We are almost entirely distributed, with leadership spread across many countries.

We believe that talent is equally distributed across the globe, and we are excited to hire, develop, promote and ultimately trust a diverse group of exceptional leads to build the best, not biggest, enterprise software company.
We hire carefully and deliberately; our selection process is long and requires substantial work from applicants. It will take successful applicants three to six months to secure an offer.

This is not a place to apply if you are in a rush to find a position, it is a worthwhile place to apply if you are ambitious and long-term in your thinking about your career and the dynamics which move the world forward.

If you see clearly the rise of open source, and you understand the drivers of enterprise procurement and technical decision making, then you will understand why Canonical has such a tremendous long term advantage.

You will also understand, given the ferocity of competition and the challenges of competing in a market of giants, that we have to set a very high bar for hiring and performance.

In order to be a world leading company we select for exceptional ability as well as character, and then provide an environment which promotes teamwork and celebrates diligence, collaboration and effectiveness. All of those are easy to say but hard to do - at Canonical we are willing to be uncomfortable in pursuit of that excellence.

Nivoda is a rapidly scaling global B2B diamond and gemstone marketplace connecting jewellery retailers with competitive, high-quality suppliers worldwide. Processing $300M+ in annual transactions and operating across multiple regions, Nivoda is transforming a $350B industry that has historically been slow to modernise.
Our platform gives businesses of all sizes, from independent jewellers to major retail chains access to the world's best diamond and gemstone inventory, without the traditional barriers of capital, geography, or information asymmetry.

Diamond and gemstone trading has long been plagued by inefficiency, opacity, and exclusivity. Nivoda was built to change that - to democratise access and empower every business, regardless of size or location, to buy and sell with confidence. Independent jewellers are at the heart of this mission. They deserve the same access to quality, pricing, and selection as the biggest players in the industry. That's exactly what we give them.

Our Sales team is the engine that brings Nivoda's mission to life. We're a high-energy, globally distributed group that moves fast, owns outcomes, and genuinely cares about the success of every jewellery business we work with. This is a team that thrives on commercial creativity, deep customer relationships, and relentless execution and we're growing fast.

You take a booked demo and turn it into a live, transacting Nivoda customer. That means running a compelling demo of the marketplace, navigating commercial negotiation, closing the contract, shepherding the customer through KYC/onboarding compliance, and owning the account through its first 90 days — first search, first order, first reorder.
This is not a pure "close and toss" role. The first 90 days are where marketplace customers form habits or churn silently, so you are accountable for activation, not just signature. You need to understand how two-sided marketplaces work — liquidity, supply trust, transaction mechanics — and ideally how the jewellery trade buys.
What will you be doing? 😎
Run discovery-led demos that map Nivoda's marketplace to the retailer's actual buying workflow.
Manage the deal: proposal, commercial terms, objection handling, multi-stakeholder buy-in, close.
Drive KYC and compliance to completion without letting momentum die — chase documents, unblock friction.
Own days 0–90: get the customer searching, quoting, and placing first orders; set usage habits early.
Coordinate with SDRs on handoff quality and with AMs on a clean day-90 transition (account context, buying patterns, risks).
Forecast accurately and keep pipeline stages honest.
What do we need from you? 💪
3–6 years closing experience, with background in a marketplace (B2B or transactional B2C — think platforms where you sold liquidity and trust, not just software) or in the jewellery/diamond industry with commercial exposure.
You understand marketplace dynamics: why the first transaction matters more than the contract, how supply breadth wins deals, what makes buyers switch procurement behaviour.
Strong demo craft: you sell workflows and outcomes, not feature tours.
Comfortable with operational follow-through — KYC, onboarding, activation — because signature is the midpoint, not the finish line.
Structured negotiator; calm with pushback on pricing and terms.
KPIs
Demo-to-close conversion, closed contracts/new business revenue
KYC completion time
90-day activation rate (first order + reorder)
Day-90 account value at handoff
Forecast accuracy

About Hiya
At Hiya, we’re making business calls more trusted, useful, and effective.
Voice remains one of the most important ways businesses communicate with their customers, but the value of a call depends on trust. When customers do not recognize who is calling or why, important conversations are missed, customer relationships suffer, and business outcomes are harder to achieve.
Hiya helps businesses create trusted calling experiences that benefit both sides of the conversation: enterprises can reach customers with confidence, and customers can answer with confidence. Our products support branded business calling, trusted caller identity, call performance insights, customer engagement, and voice security capabilities that help businesses strengthen relationships and improve outcomes.
This role sits in a core business area for Hiya and is focused on helping SMB and enterprise customers succeed.

Hiya is growing its SMB customer base across the UK and Europe, and this role exists to ensure those customers stay, grow, and succeed.
This role sits within Hiya Connect - our branded calling product. Hiya Connect Branded Call enables businesses to display their verified brand name, logo, and call reason on outbound calls, helping customers recognize trusted calls, increase answer rates, and improve engagement.
As a Bilingual Customer Success Account Manager, SMB, you’ll own a high-volume portfolio of 300+ customers. You’ll make commercial decisions every day about how to prioritise your time, engage customers, and create growth across your book of business. The pace is fast and the portfolio is broad.
Our European base is growing quickly, and this role is for someone who can work with customers in German, French or Spanish as well as English. Holding a renewal or pricing conversation in a customer’s own language builds trust faster, and at this end of the market that speed matters.
This role is perfect for someone who enjoys autonomy, thrives in a high-velocity environment and wants genuine ownership of customer outcomes, with a clear path into more strategic account management as Hiya continues to scale across Europe.

Own a portfolio of 300+ SMB accounts across the UK and Europe, with full accountability for renewals and expansion
Manage your European accounts in German, French or Spanish as well as English
Triage your book daily - identify which accounts need intervention and which are healthy enough to run digitally
Run proactive outreach to at-risk accounts before they become churn conversations
Identify natural expansion signals - usage growth, new teams, new use cases and convert them into upsell opportunities
Forecast portfolio performance and maintain accurate CRM records
Surface patterns from your book of business that help Sales, Product, and Support improve how Hiya serves SMB customers
Balance short-term renewal pressure with longer-term account health, making clear tradeoffs under volume

2+ years in Customer Success, Account Management, or a commercial SaaS role
Demonstrated ownership of renewals, expansions, or quota
Commercial instinct - able to spot a growth opportunity, build a case for it, and close it without heavy support
Clear, direct communication with customers and internal stakeholders
Comfortable working independently in an environment where not every process is fully defined
Business-level German, French or Spanish, in addition to English - confident holding renewal, pricing, and expansion conversations in that language
You’ll Likely Stand Out If You Have
Experience managing SMB or Mid-Market customers
Experience working across UK and European markets
More than one of German, French or Spanish, or an additional European language
Experience balancing personalised customer engagement with scale
Exposure to conversation intelligence, caller ID, or communications technology
How We Work
Hiya is not a passive environment. We expect people to take ownership, form opinions, and engage directly with hard problems. We work with a high degree of transparency and autonomy. Context is shared openly, and decisions are discussed, challenged, and then made. Once a call is made, we commit and move forward.
You’ll be expected to work through ambiguity, weigh tradeoffs, and take responsibility for results—while keeping a high bar for quality and customer trust.

s.h: Every team member at Hiya is expected to live our core values
s.t:
Serve, our customers and partners by holding a high bar for trust and quality
Own, share in success and open up to failures
Lead, listen, show up with a point of view but commit entirely once a decision has been made
Improve, even if it means changing course or contradicting ourselves
Do, rather than observe

We're building a team with diverse perspectives, identities, and professional experiences. We evaluate candidates through a business lens and believe that diversity and unique viewpoints make our company stronger, more dynamic, and a great place to build a career.
We've been recognized by Built In, GeekWire, Comparably, G2, Forbes, and Deloitte Technology Fast 500 for our culture, innovation, leadership, compensation, and more. At Hiya, we're a people-centric company focused on helping each employee grow both personally and professionally.

We create a culture of support and empowerment that challenges the status quo, resulting in an energized team that's passionate about their work. You'll love working here if you're looking for an innovative challenge that's disrupting an industry. Come join us!

CareSteps begleitet sie dabei mit gezielten Qualifizierungsangeboten und Vorbereitungskursen auf die Kenntnisprüfung. Als Marke des AZAV-zertifizierten Bildungsträgers StartSteps verbinden wir Bildung mit konkreten beruflichen Perspektiven.

Eine verlässliche Pipeline aufbauen: Du dokumentierst Kontakte, nächste Schritte und Ergebnisse im CRM und behältst Umsatzpotenziale und geplante Kursstarts im Blick.
CareSteps im Markt vertreten: Du knüpfst Kontakte auf Fachveranstaltungen, in Branchennetzwerken und bei Partnerbesuchen.
Unser Wachstum mitgestalten: Du arbeitest direkt mit der Geschäftsführung zusammen und bringst Rückmeldungen aus dem Markt in die Weiterentwicklung unserer Angebote ein.

Dein Profil
Du hast Erfahrung im B2B-Vertrieb, Business Development oder Key Account Management – idealerweise im Gesundheitswesen, in der internationalen Fachkräftevermittlung oder bei einem Bildungsanbieter.
Du kannst zeigen, wie du selbst neue Kunden gewonnen und Geschäftsbeziehungen aufgebaut hast.
Du verstehst die Herausforderungen von Gesundheitseinrichtungen bei der Beschäftigung internationaler Pflegefachkräfte oder bist bereit, dich schnell und gründlich einzuarbeiten.
Bestehende Kontakte zu Krankenhäusern, Pflegeeinrichtungen oder Personalvermittlungen sind ein großes Plus.
Kenntnisse rund um berufliche Anerkennung, Kenntnisprüfung und Fördermöglichkeiten sind willkommen.
Du gehst aktiv auf Menschen zu, verhandelst sicher und bleibst auch bei längeren Entscheidungsprozessen verbindlich dran.
Du arbeitest eigenständig, strukturiert und ergebnisorientiert.
Du kommunizierst verhandlungssicher auf Deutsch und sicher auf Englisch und bist bereit, Partner innerhalb Deutschlands zu besuchen.

Eine Aufgabe mit gesellschaftlicher Wirkung: Du hilfst internationalen Pflegefachkräften, beruflich anzukommen, und Gesundheitseinrichtungen, qualifiziertes Personal einzusetzen.
Viel Gestaltungsspielraum: Du prägst den Aufbau unseres B2B-Vertriebs und unseres Partnernetzwerks.
Direkte Zusammenarbeit mit der Geschäftsführung: Kurze Entscheidungswege und Raum für eigene Ideen.
Eine bestehende Grundlage: Du baust auf zertifizierten Bildungsangeboten, laufenden Kursen und ersten Partnerschaften auf.
Sichtbare Ergebnisse: Dein Erfolg zeigt sich in aktiven Partnerschaften, tatsächlichen Kursstarts und langfristigen Kundenbeziehungen.

Role Hive Robotics is building Europe’s first full-stack orchestration platform for unmanned systems: connecting, controlling, and commanding multi-vendor drone and robot swarms. As our first dedicated Account Executive, you own the sales pipeline: every opportunity from a lead to a signed contract. You take over our existing customer accounts and drive the opportunities our founders and Business Development have opened, with the first new deals expected to close within 3 months. You currently report to the CEO.
This role is customer-facing by design: expect 30–50% travel to customer sites, procurement offices, partners and trade fairs across Germany and Europe, sometimes internationally. The rest of the time you work alongside Engineering, Product Management and our Field Application Engineers.
Responsibilities Own the funnel from the first qualified conversation to signature. Our founders and Business Development open doors with customers, partners and the wider ecosystem. From there the opportunity is yours: you qualify it, drive it and close it, pulling the founders back in only when a deal needs them. Leads you generate yourself count just as much, this isn't exclusively BD's territory.
Qualify hard and early. Run discovery against a fixed gate (pain, budget, decision-making unit, timing) before we invest engineering time in a technical deep dive, and keep a clear next step with a date on every opportunity.
Lead the customer's buying team through a hardware buying cycle: end users, engineers, procurement, legal and IT, across long evaluations, equipment trials run as projects, integration questions and security reviews.
Orchestrate the deal team. Bring in our engineers and Field Application Engineers for demos, trials and technical deep dives, and Product Management for configuration and fit. You decide when a deal needs them and what they're there to do.
Own our active customers commercially: account plans, follow-on orders, upsells and expansion into new units and use cases, every escalation that touches the relationship, and regular account reviews with the Field Application Engineer who owns adoption.
Turn deployed systems into the next deal: reference visits, customer quotes and case material that you or the founders can use to open new accounts.
Own the offer: configuration and pricing, terms and conditions, the cost-benefit case on the customer's own data, and the project plan to signature. Lead our responses to RFPs and tenders where they apply, and build the templates so every proposal starts from a proven base.
Get a trial agreement signed before any trial starts: scope, duration, success criteria, pilot price and the path to the main contract. You drive it, Operations owns the paperwork.
Close, and hand over cleanly. Request the contract from Operations, keep the customer and the internal side moving, and sign. Then hand over to Operations as a confirmed customer order and to the Field Application Engineer for onboarding.
Keep the pipeline honest: stage discipline, forecast and CRM hygiene, and a weekly pipeline review you run for the founders
Requirements Must Have 7+ years in B2B sales of technical products into complex, multi-stakeholder deals, ideally in a scale up company
You have sold hardware, or hardware combined with software and firmware: physical systems with configurations, lead times, integration work and delivery commitments behind them
Comfortable selling to technical and non-technical stakeholders in the same room, and knowing when to bring in the engineers
Hands-on daily work in a CRM and a disciplined qualification method (e.g. MEDDPICC): your forecast is something the company can plan on
Closer's mindset: you treat an opportunity without a next step and a date as a problem, not a pipeline entry
Structured working style: your offers, decisions and customer commitments are written down so that Operations, the field team and the founders can act on them without asking
Willingness to travel 30–50 % across Germany and Europe, occasionally beyond Europe
Fluent English (German is a very big plus)
Eligibility and willingness to undergo security vetting for access to some customer sites
Nice to Have An existing network or experience selling to the DACH defense ecosystem: armed forces, procurement offices, primes, integrators
Technical fluency in RF communication, embedded systems, unmanned systems, command-and-control or robotics
Experience building a sales pipeline or sales function from scratch rather than inheriting one
